claim: A brown, red or black spider placed flipped (cstat 8) is given no gravity at load (its flags are OR-ed with 9, not set to 15), so it hangs on the ceiling until it wakes, when it gains gravity and loses the flip; unflipped ones get flags 15 and fall. The spider mother is not in that case: she keeps the flags she was placed with until she wakes.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/ai.cpp:1644-1651 (aiInitSprite): spider types with cstat&8 get flags |= 9, otherwise flags = 15 (kPhysGravity is 0x2, common_game.h:518)
NBlood/source/blood/src/ai.cpp:745-749 and :758-762 (aiActivateDude): a waking spider or mother gets flags |= 2 and cstat &= ~8
use: Hang spiders upside down with their drawn top against the ceiling (E2M8's lair); a mother hung so must be placed without the gravity flag.

checked.how: ai.cpp:1644-1651 (aiInitSprite) read: spider types with cstat&8 get flags |= 9, otherwise flags = 15; ai.cpp:745-749 and :758-762 (aiActivateDude): flags |= 2 and cstat &= ~8; common_game.h:517-518: kPhysMove 0x0001, kPhysGravity 0x0002.
